releases.title: ArchTitan 2.0
releases.tagline: A new era of desktop computing.

highlights.title: Redesigned Titan Control Center
highlights.body: Liquid Glass quick toggles with expandable Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, audio sink and power profile sub-drawers.

highlights.title: 2×5 Mission Control Workspace Matrix
highlights.body: Instant drag-and-drop window relocation across ten workspaces with 1:1 touchpad gesture stepping.

highlights.title: THM v3.4 Workload Orchestration
highlights.body: 5 Hz Hyprland-context CPU & memory plane management with bounded 30s recent-focus protection.

highlights.title: 11 Curated Themes & Adaptive Glass
highlights.body: Switch seamlessly between ArchTitan Signature, Catppuccin Mocha, Nord, Tokyo Night, Dracula and more.
